description: Hand-labeled sentences with deliberately inserted unsupported claims. label=unsupported means a correct critic should flag the sentence; label=supported means it should not. Sources are short synthetic excerpts written for this test set.

sources.S1: LangGraph has a built-in persistence layer implemented through checkpointers. The checkpointer saves a checkpoint of the graph state at every super-step. Checkpoints are saved to a thread that can be accessed after execution.
sources.S2: In our 2025 survey of 400 data engineering teams, 62 percent reported piloting AI agents for pipeline maintenance. Only 18 percent had deployed agents in production, citing reliability and governance concerns.
sources.S3: Global mean sea level has risen about 10 centimetres since 1993, according to satellite altimetry. Thermal expansion of seawater and melting of glaciers and ice sheets are the main contributors.
sources.S4: Perovskite solar cells have reached certified laboratory efficiencies above 26 percent, but their long-term stability under heat and moisture remains a barrier to commercialisation.
